Hair handoff — all nine transformations

The provenance fix is applied to every rung. At each handoff the complete source hairstyle stops being rendered and the destination hairstyle takes its place: one hair owner per pixel, never two hairstyles at once, and nothing enlarged or thickened to hide the source. Two further duplicate-hair sources were found and removed while extending it — the aura layer and the frame-24 destination layer each bundled the form's rear hair at the unfitted offset, which put a second misaligned copy of the hairstyle behind the fitted one. Because SSJ1, SSJ2 and SSJ3 share the gold ramp, that copy read as the source form's hair.
